title: Adopt Supabase as the sole canonical core backend platform
approvedDelta: Supabase is the sole canonical backend platform for SiloMath application runtime. PostgreSQL remains the authoritative enterprise datastore. Server-authoritative operations are implemented using Supabase PostgreSQL functions and/or Edge Functions. Android direct access is allowed only where explicitly permitted by the API/security contract and RLS. Critical mutations remain server-authoritative, atomic and idempotent. No separate application backend or external compute service is canonical for core business operations; non-core auxiliary services may not become authoritative for core business state without a future approved Baseline Change.
supersededTargetImplementation: separate Kotlin/Ktor application backend as canonical runtime
Render or equivalent external compute as canonical core backend runtime
JDBC hop from separate application backend to Supabase as required target topology
rvmImpact: Register FD-76; preserve existing semantic verification and replace provider/topology evidence with Supabase Auth/PostgreSQL/RLS/Edge Functions/Storage evidence. Add proof that critical mutations cannot bypass approved server-authoritative paths and that core business state has no separate external-compute authority.
testImpact: Add Supabase Edge Function/API, PostgreSQL RPC/transaction, RLS, Auth/session, offline sync/idempotency/version, Storage integrity/security and environment promotion tests. Ktor/Render/JDBC-specific tests cease to be baseline acceptance evidence after migration closure.
